title: A send batch that held every lead was missing its lines input, not judging the leads
hypothesis: gtme batch would find each lead's personal line.
result: All 252 Firm Foundation SoCal leads were held because nobody passed --lines. cf6c0b62 made batch and today read the ledger's own lines.json.
next_decision: Pass --lines only to override the ledger's lines.json.
check: When a batch holds every lead, check which inputs it read before blaming the leads.
scope: gtme batch and gtme today for any one-sender client.
